title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is buzzing with activity as major players navigate launches, military contracts, and strategic partnerships. From Blue Origin's investigation closure to SpaceX's latest Starship launch, the landscape is shifting rapidly.

themes.title: Military Contracts on the Rise
themes.body: The Space Force's recent $437 million award to Viasat and SES underscores a growing emphasis on military satellite networks. This trend reflects an ongoing commitment to bolster national security through enhanced space capabilities.

themes.title: Launch Developments Heat Up
themes.body: SpaceX's debut of Starship V3 marks a significant milestone in its ambitious launch schedule. Meanwhile, Blue Origin's investigation into the New Glenn failure wraps up, potentially paving the way for future launches.

themes.title: Strategic Partnerships Emerge
themes.body: Anduril and L3Harris are teaming up for a tactical SDA constellation bid, highlighting the trend of collaboration in the defense sector. This partnership reflects a strategic pivot towards dual-use technologies amid rising geopolitical tensions.

themes.title: Budget Increases for Space Resilience
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup adding $1.4 billion to space resilience initiatives signals a robust commitment to fortifying U.S. capabilities in space. As threats evolve, so too does the funding landscape, prioritizing resilience and modernization.
